memories.name: We Demand a Parlay
memories.objective: Shadow Hornigold and Rogers, then lift the fort plans from the fortress in northeast Nassau (coords 606, 766).
steps: Follow Hornigold and Rogers over the rooftops to the tavern.
Once they leave, talk to Anne Bonny, who points you to the plans.
Enter the garrisoned fort from the southeastern wooden structure, not the front gate.
Work along the southwest edge to the fort's Viewpoint, whistling from ledges to draw soldiers off one by one.
Kill the three guards at the top, drop to the western side for a chest, then climb back and sync the Viewpoint.
Leap into a nearby haystack to get down fast and take a second chest close by.
Go south to the alarm bell, wait for a patrolling brute to wander off, clear the area and sabotage the bell.
Ambush the brute from the bushes before he can raise the alarm.
Round the corner to the plans, double-assassinate the two guards and finish the last soldier.
Take the plans (cutscene), then leave the fort.
tips: Rooftops keep you hidden in the soldier-heavy city.
gaps: No enemy counts or reinforcement behaviour for the fort.
No chest contents or exact chest locations beyond 'western side' and 'nearby'.

memories.name: The Gunpowder Plot
memories.objective: Follow Charles Vane and tag the gunpowder kegs that are part of the escape plan.
steps: Return to the tavern and follow Vane to the kegs.
Tag nearby soldiers with Eagle Vision.
Head east and assassinate the lone guard outside a cave entrance.
In the cave, clear the guards around the first two kegs from the bushes, then tag both kegs.
Leave to the southeast and climb the stairs, killing the guard at the top.
Continue south to a second camp, climb a nearby building and tag most remaining soldiers with Eagle Vision.
Kill the guard facing away from a tent.
Double-assassinate the pair watching the next keg, then tag it.
Go further south: clear a patrol near bushes, then a guard, then a pair, then the brute guarding a cart; this tags the last keg and ends the memory.
Grab the nearby Viewpoint before finding Vane for the next memory.
tips: Eagle Vision from rooftops helps plan routes.
Clear enemies in the listed order to keep the camp quiet.
gaps: Exact keg and Viewpoint coordinates are not given.
Number of guards per camp is not stated.

memories.name: Commodore Eighty-Sixed
memories.objective: Hunt down and assassinate the British Commodore near Nassau (page suggests saving first).
steps: Meet Vane on Nassau's northern beach (coords 592, 766).
Tail a Captain who may know the Commodore's whereabouts, using rooftops and bushes.
Follow him toward a mansion.
Kill the soldier on scaffolding facing the mansion and deal with reinforcements one at a time.
Climb the north side of the house and loot a balcony chest.
Go up to the roof, take the nearby Eagle point and drop in through an open window.
Inside, check the painting, clue and treasure chest on the south side, and read the note to the west.
Eavesdrop by the northern door, which reveals the Commodore is not here.
Head southeast to the beach camp (coords 601, 748).
Assassinate three patrolling guards near the southern edge.
Loot a nearby chest, then lure and clear a guard near a tent from a bush to the north.
Sneak up and assassinate the Commodore.
After he dies, follow Vane to the beach and board the Jackdaw.
tips: If spotted, quick-draw a weapon to break his stance; dodge red attacks and parry blue ones.
gaps: The note's contents and what the Eagle point shows are not described.
Treasure chest contents are not stated.

memories.name: The Fireship
memories.objective: Break out of the Nassau blockade by sea and return to Great Inagua.
steps: After the Commodore's death, talk to Anne Bonny before sailing.
Sail east to meet the Fireship and stay close as British ships close in.
Protect the Fireship; disable larger ships rather than sinking them so they can be used for repairs.
Clear smaller boats with Heated Shot.
Board or finish the larger ships once small threats are gone.
Fire on the Fireship so it rams the blockade, and keep back while it explodes.
Continue to coords 632, 923 to leave Nassau.
Optionally fight pursuers or just outrun them.
After the cutscene back at Great Inagua, follow Adewale to meet James Kidd at the docks.
tips: Disabling large ships instead of sinking them keeps them available for repairs.
gaps: No details on the pursuit force.
No mention of how many ships make up the blockade.
